nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build-context exclusion list for the Django backend, preventing Python bytecode artifacts, virtual environments, secrets (.env), VCS/IDE metadata, generated static and media directories, and Docker configuration files from being sent to the daemon.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Docker Compose configuration that provisions a PostgreSQL 15 Alpine database service with a named persistent volume and a pg_isready health check; the backend application container is not defined here, making this a database-only compose file.
nodes.languageNotes: Only the db service is declared; the Django/gunicorn application container is absent, suggesting it is started separately or the compose file is intentionally database-only for local development.

nodes.name: db
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL 15 Alpine database service with credentials for projet_db, exposed on port 5432 with a persistent named volume and a pg_isready health check.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Single-stage Docker build for the Django REST backend, installing system and Python dependencies from requirements.txt, copying the project, creating a non-root django-user, and launching the application via Gunicorn on port 8000 serving the labconnect WSGI entrypoint.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a non-root user (django-user) for security hardening and relies on libpq-dev for PostgreSQL client bindings; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE and PYTHONUNBUFFERED are set to optimize container logging and avoid .pyc clutter.
